summary: Acuity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Credit Agreement for an $800 million unsecured revolving credit facility maturing May 2031, replacing a prior 2022 facility. The facility bears interest at SOFR/EURIBOR/etc. plus a margin based on leverage or credit rating, with a quarterly facility fee. It includes a maximum leverage ratio covenant of 3.75x (temporarily up to 4.25x for material acquisitions), customary restrictions, and guarantees from material domestic subsidiaries. This is a routine refinancing of an existing credit line, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
